description.en:
The two-handed game controller as one parametric archetype: a rounded bridge plus 0, 2 or 3 tapered grips on a flat bottom, crowned by one analytic surface that every control seat shares — brick, crescent, dogbone, handles and trident body plans, one-piece or split into halves on rails or magnets. D-pad, up to eight face buttons in five arrangements, sticks, bumpers, analogue triggers, an under-trigger, touchpad, ports and expansion slots. Archetype presets only: no logos, no button glyphs, no outline fitted to any product.

Official Visualizer and Configurator: Yantra4D
description.es:
El control de videojuego a dos manos como un arquetipo paramétrico: un puente redondeado más 0, 2 o 3 empuñaduras ahusadas sobre una base plana, coronado por una sola superficie analítica que comparten todos los asientos de control — planes de ladrillo, media luna, hueso, asas y tridente, de una pieza o dividido en mitades sobre rieles o imanes. Cruceta, hasta ocho botones en cinco disposiciones, palancas, botones de hombro, gatillos analógicos, gatillo inferior, panel táctil, puertos y ranuras de expansión. Sólo preajustes de arquetipo: sin logotipos, sin glifos de botón, sin contornos ajustados a ningún producto.

Visualizador y configurador oficial: Yantra4D

cdg_interfaces.standard: internal: the `envelope` mode — the uncut planform (bridge + grips) on a flat bottom, crowned by the one analytic crown. Projecting parts (sticks, caps, triggers, the cable stub) excluded, as makers measure.

internal: each grip is the hull of a root circle (grip_root_radius at ±grip_root_x, grip_root_y) and a tip circle (grip_tip_radius, grip_length along grip_splay_deg), standing on z = 0 and topped by the crown. What a controller mount, stand or grip cover holds.

internal: a T rail along Y on each half's inner face (split = rail_halves): flange rail_width wide, stem half that, standing 2.0 mm off the face, rail_length long, centred on (crown_center_y, mid-thickness). The male half of the slide a tablet's side slot (the planned slab-handheld family) or a grip consumes.

internal: a 4 mm-radius strain-relief stub along +Y from the shoulder edge, at x = 0 (top_center) or x = -bridge_width/4 (top), mid-thickness. The seat the planned cable-assembly family's boot mates with.

internal: 1 or 2 rectangular slots, expansion_slot_width x expansion_slot_thickness, expansion_slot_depth deep from the top face (at the crown) or the underside (from the centre grip's floor). What a plug-in pack of the planned plug-in-media family inserts into.

societal_benefit.en: A dimensioned, parametric controller body lets anyone fabricate a stand, a wall mount, a grip cover, a travel case or a repair fixture that fits the controllers people own — including ones whose maker is gone — without copying any maker's design.
societal_benefit.es: Un cuerpo de control paramétrico y acotado permite a cualquiera fabricar un soporte, un montaje de pared, una funda de empuñadura, un estuche o un útil de reparación que encaje con los controles que la gente tiene — incluso aquellos cuyo fabricante ya no existe — sin copiar el diseño de ningún fabricante.

composition.vocabulary: plan §2.3 (components are hyperobjects too); ruling R2 settles gate H8: components are canonical text in commons-lib/hardware/, inlined at build.
composition.note: A controller is a hyperobject of hyperobjects. family.py maps this manifest's parameters onto each component's own dict; main.py is generated by tools/inline_parts.py. No graph twin: the crown and the grip hulls need expressions and lofts the node graph does not have.

description.en: The body and every cap in world coordinates. A preview, not a print target: the caps are separate bodies.
description.es: El cuerpo y cada tapa en coordenadas de mundo. Una vista previa, no un objetivo de impresión: las tapas son cuerpos separados.

description.en: A flat-topped planform hull filling the archetype crown: a conservative fit proxy whose bounding dimensions follow the published envelope. Projecting controls and split displacement excluded.
description.es: Contorno plano que rellena la curvatura del arquetipo: una envolvente conservadora cuyas cotas siguen las dimensiones publicadas. Sin controles salientes ni desplazamiento de mitades.

description.en: The half at x < 0 with its rail or magnets. Meaningful when split; on a one-piece pad it is just the left half of the body.
description.es: La mitad en x < 0 con su riel o imanes. Tiene sentido con división; en un control de una pieza es sólo la mitad izquierda del cuerpo.

tooltip.en: Brick: the bridge alone. Crescent: a concave front edge. Dogbone: round end lobes. Handles and trident: 2 or 3 tapered grips (grip_count). Outlines come from these written rules, never from a product.
tooltip.es: Ladrillo: sólo el puente. Media luna: borde frontal cóncavo. Hueso: lóbulos redondos. Asas y tridente: 2 o 3 empuñaduras (grip_count). Los contornos salen de estas reglas escritas, nunca de un producto.

tooltip.en: Z, the body alone: grips stand on z = 0, the crown's top is z = thickness. In a preset: the smaller of the published height and depth.
tooltip.es: Z, sólo el cuerpo: las empuñaduras se apoyan en z = 0 y la cima de la corona es z = espesor. En un preajuste: la menor de la altura y la profundidad publicadas.

message.en: A stick well this deep pierces the body.

message.en: The trigger and bumper notches nearly meet at the shoulder edge.
message.es: Las muescas de gatillo y de hombro casi se tocan en el borde.

message.en: The grip tips are too slender to hollow; the shells keep them solid.
message.es: Las puntas son demasiado delgadas para vaciarse; las carcasas las dejan macizas.
